positiveFindings: Accurately identifies that current AI preview and local Run consume different sources, and makes immutable confirmed-artifact execution a prerequisite.
Defines explicit step intent over local/global defaults, stable IDs through reorder/copy, optimistic save-before-compile, context hashing and stale-result rejection.
Keeps authoring schema v2 separate from unchanged artifact v1, and permits bounded allowed statements without weakening source-step alignment.
Independent explicit literal/reference slots and complete action-signature checks avoid treating originalText equality or a model assertion as semantic proof.
Included live learning has bounded session/state identity, once-only advance, scope authorization, cleanup and atomic evidence publication; ordinary Compile remains browser-free and Execute LLM-free.
Behavioral evidence is tied to the learned source/action and state generations; regenerated source cannot inherit proof that different code was exercised.
validationPerformed: Read spec, requirements, complexity, research and architecture assessment.
Cross-checked actual compiler, request/parser/API and artifact schema with existing architecture sections 4, 8 and 9.
Checked all FR/AC references and the proposed acceptance layers by static review. No product tests, browser sessions, model benchmark, staging validation or security approvals performed.
productionGates: Verify incomplete Epic 10 contracts, trusted validator/executor, immutable revisions and confirmed-artifact run path.
Freeze and test shared API/schema, migrations and actual pinned runtime compatibility.
Verify authenticated capture, restricted egress, retention/sanitization policy and isolated browser cleanup in the intended environment.
Run pinned real-model/page fixture corpus and establish measured latency/context/cost/task-success release thresholds.

resolvedIssues.resolution: Section 3.3 defines supplied/predicted/observed provenance and allows only capture of the actual state in its current session generation to establish observation.
Section 3.7 assigns vault-reference resolution to the authorized backend/worker, encrypted ephemeral delivery to the runner, and explicitly denies runner vault/CSI-store/LLM credentials.

secondReviewChecks: User-selected live inspection remains included, with Start learning authorizing a displayed plan/action scope once; unchanged unambiguous validated actions can auto-advance.
Per-session budgets, revision/state-generation identity, once-only advance and atomic final publication are specified; uncertain outcomes cannot trigger hidden replay.
Learned behavioral evidence binds exact code/action hashes and pre/post state generations; regenerated or dependency-changed steps lose behavioral verification.
The baseline no-browser ordinary Compile and no-LLM Execute boundaries remain intact.
Versioned authoring and immutable metadata do not silently expand artifact V1 fields or limits.
Supplied context can operate when inspection is unavailable, but delivering only that path does not fulfill the complete user-selected feature.
planningTestReminders: Translate session guarantees into explicit duplicates/lost-response/stale-generation/cancel-race/final-publication-conflict tests.
Include extra and missing AST actions, literal argument-position swaps, ambiguous quoting, typed-slot conflicts and reference substitution tests.
Verify regenerated learned source clears behavioral proof for affected and dependent steps.
